title: Nova Twins Open Rock in Rio 2026's Palco Mundo
seoTitle: Nova Twins Open Rock in Rio 2026's Palco Mundo
subtitle: Britain's Georgia South and bassist Amy Love arrive in Brazil for a high-impact show
excerpt: Georgia South, of Nova Twins, arrives in Brazil to open Rock in Rio 2026's Palco Mundo. The British duo mixes punk, grime and alt rock and has already received.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Georgia South, from Nova Twins, arrives in Brazil to open Rock in Rio 2026's Palco Mundo. The British duo mixes punk, grime, and alternative rock and has already received Grammy nominations.

Georgia South and Amy Love arrive in Brazil

On Wednesday, Georgia South arrived in Brazil and, amid the anticipation, got a massage on the sands of Ipanema Beach to prepare for the show.

She posted on Instagram that she is "warming up her neck for the 'bangover' that is coming tomorrow," explaining that the term means pain and stiffness in the neck and shoulders after a show.

What to expect from Nova Twins' set

The London duo, formed by guitarist and vocalist Amy Love and bassist Georgia South, usually compensates for the short duration of festival sets with an electric stage presence.

Among the band's hits are “Antagonist”, “Vortex”, and “Play Fair”.

Schedule and live coverage

The show takes place on Friday, September 4th, at 4:40 PM, on the Palco Mundo. The live broadcast on TV Globo begins at 4:40 PM, with extra coverage in 4K for Globoplay premium subscribers.

Coverage on the channel begins much earlier, starting at 3:15 PM, showing all stages. The highlights are broadcast during the late-night programming, right after the show Conversa com Bial.

Upcoming commitments in Brazil

Two days after Rock in Rio, on September 6th, Nova Twins will perform at the É Tudo Delas event, at Cine Joia, in São Paulo, alongside The Mönic and MC Taya.

With information from O GLOBO, Terra, Rede Atlântida.
